verdict.rationale: LegalOS hosts a dedicated O-1A eligibility checker on its own site: answer a few questions in about 2 minutes and get a personalized assessment from immigration attorneys, which matches the self-serve structured qualifier in the story. The EB-1A page describes assessing category fit only as part of the paid service, and the fee calculator only estimates fees rather than checking eligibility. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation the checker is free, a self-serve EB-1A qualifier, clarity on whether results are instant or attorney follow-up, independent/hands-on corroboration.
